classification_definitions.EVIDENCE_MISSING: a required sealed candidate field is absent or structurally invalid; no field is inferred

input_binding.candidate_slot_denominator: 12 parents x 6 ordered candidates = 72; parent-level aggregation is primary

parent_failure_category_definitions.EVIDENCE_MISSING: one or more candidate rows cannot be classified from sealed fields
parent_failure_category_definitions.JOINT_LIMITED: native OPEN and exact-arm candidates occur separately, but no candidate satisfies both
parent_failure_category_definitions.SELECTIVITY_LIMITED: native OPEN occurs, but no candidate preserves exact arm tokens
parent_failure_category_definitions.STRICT_REALIZABLE: at least one candidate is ARM_EXACT_AND_NATIVE_OPEN
